text: Market Claim is to transfer proceeds received from the issuer to the entitled party.
Market Claim is to compensate the entitled party in cash by the party that failed to fulfil its obligation. No proceeds have been received from the issuer.
Market Claim is to transfer proceeds partially received from the issuer to the entitled party. Part is compensated in cash by the party that failed to fulfil its obligation.
Market claim that has been created due to a pending/failing settlement transaction, to ensure the event proceeds are delivered from the seller to the buyer.
Market claim that has been created due to a settled settlement transaction, to ensure the event proceeds are delivered from the buyer to the seller.
